# Userlist

Userlist is a full-stack email automation platform designed for SaaS companies, enabling targeted behavior-based campaigns through email and in-app messages.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/userlist/.

## Actions

- **Delete Company from Userlist**: Delete a company from userlist.
- **Push User-Company Relationship**: Create or update a relationship between a user and a company in userlist.
